unit: one immutable qualified claim and its revision

state_operations.retract: refuted old claim is excluded from aggregation support
state_operations.replace: old claim refuted and same-ID same-candidate replacement independently supported
state_operations.defer: insufficient evidence retains an explicitly uncertain hypothesis

verification.catalog_facts: exact bounded genre/year grammar compared against frozen catalog
verification.natural_language: label-isolated model proxy with decisive exact evidence spans

scope_controls: reviewer and owner are separate identities
candidate binding and claim identity immutable
no ranking edits in a patch
active and uncertain evidence projected separately to final aggregation
checkpoint_controls: canonical fresh and cached response objects
manifest includes source and data hashes
paid raw response saved before parsing
known raw responses can be parsed offline
budget: reserve input UTF8 upper bound and maximum output before every initial, review, verification and aggregation dispatch

controlled_acceptance.scope: execution correctness on bounded catalog facts, not natural-language or recommendation efficacy

next_gates: complete equal-information baseline and runtime-verifier ablation protocol
only then a newly frozen comparative pilot
e3_design_correction: Removing a posthoc evaluator is not a method ablation; the experimental removal must affect the runtime verifier, patch scope, routing or unresolved policy.
